objective: Test whether archived model-specific inner validation, amplitude and complexity improve prediction of held-out partner gain, then test training-only model selection
scope: Reuse existing measurements, coefficients, predictions and inner scores; no retraining biological predictors
features: Inner endpoint-projected gain and full-response gain kept separate; correction reward/cost when recoverable; inner contrast dimensions, amplitude, regularization, effective degrees where defined
validation: Purged whole queried-combination groups, whole panels and whole studies; no random row split. Leave-source tests remain retrospective
regression: Fixed standardized ridge alpha=1; compare same-row data-only baseline, inner-gain-only, combined and complexity models. Persist all candidates and both success/failure outcomes
selection: Compare zero correction, maximum inner partner gain, maximum inner full-response gain, and cross-fitted regression choices on identical eligible candidate pools. Zero is always available. No outer-score-based threshold tuning
weighting: Balance panels and training configurations. Repeated archive aliases split their weight. Keep baseline and validation metric distinctions explicit
eligibility: Missing inner coefficients or nonmatching metric are disclosed, not fabricated. Recoverable diagnostic regularized rank-one outputs can be rescored from already saved predictions
